property: every eligible segment lands in exactly one of the four statuses or in the unmapped list
generator: segments 1..=24
generator: status per segment drawn from MAPPED|EXCLUDED_NON_SPEECH|REDACTED_WITH_POLICY|UNTRANSCRIBED_FAILURE|UNMAPPED
generator: tokens per segment 1..=8
invariant: accounts + unmapped == eligible, and no index appears twice
invariant: a witness exists only when unmapped == 0
